description: Create a contact named Northwind and see it in the kanban column new.
steps: Choose Ada as the acting user.
Create a contact named Northwind.
See Northwind in the kanban column new.

description: An empty contact name is refused and no contact is added.
steps: Choose Ada as the acting user.
Submit the create-contact form with an empty name.
See the error code contact.name.required.
See that no contact named with an empty name was added.

description: Qualifying Northwind moves that contact to the column qualified.
steps: Open the contact Northwind.
Fill email northwind@example.com and company Northwind.
Click Validate.
See the column qualified.

description: Sending an estimate moves Northwind to estimate sent and the page shows This is a test.
steps: On the qualified contact Northwind, set Cable quantity to 2 and Lamp quantity to 1.
See the grand total 25.
Click Validate estimate.
See the column estimate sent.
See the text This is a test.

description: Sending an estimate for a qualified contact with an empty email is refused and the column stays qualified.
steps: Open a qualified contact whose email is empty.
Add Cable quantity 2 and Lamp quantity 1 and click Validate estimate.
See the error code contact.email.required.
See that the column is still qualified.

description: Ada sees Northwind on the kanban, the contact list, and the estimate list. Ben does not.
steps: As Ada, create Northwind, qualify it, and send the estimate.
See Northwind on the kanban, the contact list, and the estimate list.
Choose Ben as the acting user.
See that Northwind is absent from the kanban, the contact list, and the estimate list.

description: Create a user named Dana and see that user in the user list. The count includes Dana.
steps: Choose Ada as the acting user.
Create a user named Dana.
See Dana on the user list.
See the count include Dana.

description: An empty user name is refused and no user is added.
steps: Choose Ada as the acting user.
Submit the create-user form with an empty name.
See the error code user.name.required.
See that no user with an empty name was added.

description: A duplicate user name is refused.
steps: Choose Ada as the acting user.
Submit the create-user form with the name Ada.
See the error code user.name.taken.
See that a second Ada was not added.

description: Update a user's name.
steps: Open the user Ada.
Change the name to Ada Lovelace and update.
See the name Ada Lovelace.

description: Deleting a user who still owns a contact is refused and the user stays.
steps: As Ada, create a contact.
Delete the user Ada.
See the error code user.delete.blocked.
See that Ada is still a user.

description: Deleting a user who owns no contact removes that user and clears the acting user when it was that user. The next page uses the first remaining user.
steps: Create a user named Dana who owns no contact.
Choose Dana as the acting user.
Delete Dana.
See that Dana is gone and the acting user is the first remaining user.

description: Update a contact name, email, and company. The column stays and no email is sent.
steps: Open a contact in column estimate sent.
Change the name, clear the email, and clear the company.
See the new name.
See the column estimate sent.
See that no new email was sent.

description: An empty contact name on update is refused.
steps: Open a contact.
Submit the update form with an empty name.
See the error code contact.name.required.
See that the stored name did not change.

description: Delete a contact and its estimates, estimate lines, and sent emails. Another user's contact stays 404.
steps: As Ada, open Northwind after the estimate was sent.
As Ben, open that contact and see 404.
As Ada, delete the contact.
See that the contact, its estimates, its lines, and its sent emails are gone.

description: Create a product with a name and a unit price and see it in the product list. The count includes it.
steps: Choose Ada as the acting user.
Create a product named Plug with unit price 3.
See Plug on the product list.
See the count include Plug.

description: An empty product name is refused.
steps: Choose Ada as the acting user.
Submit the create-product form with an empty name.
See the error code product.name.required.

description: A duplicate product name is refused.
steps: Choose Ada as the acting user.
Submit a product named Cable when Cable already exists.
See the error code product.name.taken.

description: A product unit price that is not an unsigned integer is refused.
steps: Choose Ada as the acting user.
Submit a product with a negative unit price.
See the error code product.unit_price.invalid.

description: A product price change does not rewrite stored line prices or past grand totals.
steps: Send an estimate with Cable quantity 2 and Lamp quantity 1. The grand total is 25.
Change Cable's unit price to 12.
See the stored Cable line unit price still 10.
See the saved grand total still 25.

description: Deleting a product that is on an estimate line is refused.
steps: Send an estimate that uses Cable.
Delete Cable.
See the error code product.delete.blocked.
See that Cable is still a product.

description: Update an estimate's quantities. The grand total is recomputed from current product prices. The column stays and no email is sent.
steps: Change Cable's unit price to 12 after an estimate was sent.
Update that estimate to Cable quantity 1.
See the grand total 12.
See the stored line unit price 12.
See the column still estimate sent.
See that no new email was sent.

description: An estimate update with no quantity of at least 1 is refused.
steps: Open an estimate.
Set every quantity to 0 and update.
See the error code estimate.lines.required.
See that the saved grand total did not change.

description: Delete an estimate and its lines. The contact column stays and the sent email stays.
steps: Open an estimate whose contact is estimate sent.
Delete the estimate.
See that the estimate and its lines are gone.
See the column still estimate sent.
See the sent email still on the contact.

description: The user PDF response is application/pdf.
steps: Open a user.
Follow the PDF link.
See a PDF file.

description: The contact PDF response is application/pdf and may include email, company, column, and This is a test. after a send.
steps: Open a contact after the estimate was sent.
Follow the PDF link.
See a PDF file.

description: The product PDF response is application/pdf.
steps: Open a product.
Follow the PDF link.
See a PDF file.

description: The estimate PDF response is application/pdf.
steps: Open an estimate.
Follow the PDF link.
See a PDF file.

description: The user CSV is text/csv, the header matches the list, and a search downloads the matching rows rather than only the current page.
steps: Create more users than one page.
Download the user CSV.
See the header row name.
See every user, not only the first page.
Search for one name and download the CSV.
See that name and not the other users.

description: The contact CSV header is name and column. Email stays off the CSV.
steps: Open the contact list.
Download the contact CSV.
See the header name,column.
See that the contact email is absent.

description: The product CSV is text/csv with name and unit price.
steps: Open the product list.
Download the product CSV.
See the header name,unit_price.

description: The estimate CSV is text/csv with the contact name and grand total.
steps: Open the estimate list.
Download the estimate CSV.
See the header name,grand_total.
See the contact name and grand total.

description: The user count is every user. It ignores search and the current page. The page size is 15.
steps: Create 16 users.
Open the user list.
See 15 rows and a next page.
See the count 16.
Search for a name that matches one user.
See one row and the count still 16.

description: The contact count is the acting user's contacts. It ignores search and the current page.
steps: As Ada, create two contacts.
Search the contact list for one name.
See the count 2.
Choose Ben.
See Ben's own count, without Ada's contacts.

description: The product count is every product. It ignores search and the current page.
steps: Open the product list.
See the count of every product.
Search for one product name.
See the count unchanged.

description: The estimate count is the acting user's estimates. Search matches the contact name only.
steps: As Ada, send an estimate for Northwind.
Search the estimate list for Cable.
See no row and the count still 1.
Search for Northwind.
See that estimate.
Choose Ben.
See a count of 0.

description: Deleting a product that is on no estimate line removes that product.
steps: Create a product that is not on an estimate.
Delete that product.
See that the product is gone.
